messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

I don’t have a dedicated “fetch holidays” tool, but I can compile the long‑weekend dates for Canada in 2023 based on the statutory holidays that are observed nationwide (and note where provincial differences apply).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) | Observed Mon Jan 2 | Dec 31 – Jan 2 | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon). |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | Feb 18 – 20 | Only in those provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | Apr 7 – 8 | Friday‑Saturday. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | May 20 – 22 | Sat‑Mon. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed Mon Jul 3 | Jul 1 – 3 | Sat‑Mon. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | Sep 2 – 4 | Sat‑Mon. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | Oct 7 – 9 | Sat‑Mon. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Thursday) | Observed Mon Nov 13 | Nov 11 – 13 | Thu‑Mon. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | Dec 23 – 25 | Sat‑Mon. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | Dec 24 – 26 | Sun‑Tue. |

### How to use this in your app
1. **Filter by Province** – If you need province‑specific long weekends, add a filter for the holidays that are only observed in certain provinces (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday, etc.).
2. **Calendar Integration** – Store each span as a start and end date; you can then highlight these ranges in a calendar view.
3. **User Preferences** – Allow users to toggle whether they want to see all long weekends or just those that include a particular holiday.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of statutory holidays (including provincial ones) or if you need help formatting this data for your database!
